entry.name: AI for Everyone
entry.note: A non-technical course on what AI can and cannot do inside an organisation
entry.audience: Managers, executives and anyone working alongside technical teams

reading.cost: Free to join. A certificate requires purchase. A subscription unlocks access to 10,000+ courses.
covers: Meaning of common AI terminology including neural networks, machine learning, deep learning, and data science
What AI realistically can and cannot do
Spotting opportunities to apply AI to problems in your organization
What it feels like to build machine learning and data science projects
Working with an AI team and building an AI strategy
Navigating ethical and societal discussions surrounding AI
Workflow of a machine learning project
How to choose an AI project
reading.format: Online course delivered through Coursera with video lectures and graded assignments. Some sections are optional.
reading.summary: This course introduces artificial intelligence for a general audience. It explains common AI terms such as neural networks, machine learning, deep learning, and data science. It also covers what AI can and cannot do, how to find AI opportunities, and how to work with an AI team. Completing the course shows an understanding of AI basics and business applications.
reading.audience: The page says it is for non-technical colleagues and anyone who wants their organization to use AI better. Engineers can also take it to learn the business side of AI.
